opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi i stradanju naroda Moslavine u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the struggle and suffering of the people of Moslavina in World War II.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Kosmajskom partizanskom odredu](Q11117229), koji se na ovom terenu borio od 1941. do 1944. Spomenik visok 30 metara stoji na Malom visu, jednom od tri vrha Kosmaja.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Kosmaj Partisan Detachment](Q11117229), which fought in this area from 1941 to 1944. The 30-metre monument stands on Mali Vis, one of the three peaks of Kosmaj.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [bici na Sutjesci](Q1419973) iz maja i juna 1943, u kojoj su partizani u Dolini heroja uz velike gubitke probili nemački obruč. Kompleks je deo Nacionalnog parka Sutjeska.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Battle of the Sutjeska](Q1419973) of May and June 1943, in which the Partisans broke through the German encirclement in the Valley of Heroes at great cost. The complex is part of Sutjeska National Park.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama streljanja na Bubnju, gde su okupatori tokom rata ubili više od 10.000 ljudi iz Niša i drugih krajeva. Tri pesnice predstavljaju prkos muškaraca, žena i dece pred streljanjem.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the executions at Bubanj, where the occupiers killed more than 10,000 people from Niš and elsewhere during the war. The three fists stand for the defiance of the men, women and children facing the firing squad.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Radničkom bataljonu Užičkog partizanskog odreda, koji je 29. novembra 1941, u [bici na Kadinjači](Q12956415), izginuo braneći slobodno Užice od nemačke ofanzive.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Workers' Battalion of the Užice Partisan Detachment, which fell on 29 November 1941 in the [Battle of Kadinjača](Q12956415), defending free Užice against the German offensive.

naziv.sh: Spomenik ustanku naroda Banije i Korduna

opis.sh: Posvećeno [ustanku](Q142721) naroda Korduna i Banije i partizanskoj bolnici na Petrovoj gori. Na ovom vrhu je 1942. oko 300 seljaka, naoružanih samo vilama, poginulo jurišajući na utvrđene ustaše.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [uprising](Q142721) of the people of Kordun and Banija and to the Partisan hospital on Petrova Gora. On this peak in 1942, about 300 peasants armed only with pitchforks died storming the entrenched Ustaše.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima i narodu Kozare u [Kozaračkoj ofanzivi](Q2985697) u leto 1942, kada je poginulo oko 2.500 partizana, a 68.500 civila ubijeno ili odvedeno u ustaške logore.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters and people of Kozara in the [Kozara Offensive](Q2985697) of summer 1942, when about 2,500 Partisans were killed and 68,500 civilians were killed or deported to Ustaše camps.

opis.sh: Posvećeno rudarima i partizanima, Srbima i Albancima sa Kosova i Metohije, poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi 1941–1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to the miners and Partisans, Serbs and Albanians from Kosovo, who died in the People's Liberation War of 1941–1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno svim žrtvama [ustaškog logora Jasenovac](Q155032), u kome su tokom rata ubijene desetine hiljada Srba, Jevreja, Roma i antifašista.
opis.en: Dedicated to all the victims of the [Ustaše camp of Jasenovac](Q155032), where tens of thousands of Serbs, Jews, Roma and anti-fascists were killed during the war.

opis.sh: Posvećeno učesnicima [Ilindenskog ustanka](Q1145682) 1903. i partizanima u Makedoniji; otvoren 2. avgusta 1974, na 30. godišnjicu zasedanja ASNOM-a.
opis.en: Dedicated to the participants of the 1903 [Ilinden Uprising](Q1145682) and to the Partisans in Macedonia; opened on 2 August 1974, the 30th anniversary of the ASNOM assembly.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Čačanskog partizanskog odreda poginulim u noći 4. na 5. marta 1943, kada su četnici i žandarmi opkolili 25 partizana u obližnjoj štali; u proboju ih je poginulo četrnaest.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fourteen fighters of the Čačak Partisan Detachment killed on the night of 4–5 March 1943, when Chetniks and gendarmes surrounded 25 Partisans in a nearby barn.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima 4. jugoslovenske armije poginulim pri oslobađanju ovog kraja i prekomorskim brigadama. Pod spomenikom je zajednička grobnica 284 borca.
opis.en: Dedicated to the soldiers of the Yugoslav 4th Army who died liberating this area and to the Overseas Brigades. A common tomb beneath the monument holds 284 soldiers.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama ustaškog terora: vlasti NDH su tokom rata na ovom mestu streljale 455 ljudi. Spomen-park je razoren 1990-ih, a obnova je počela 2015.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 455 people executed here by the authorities of the Independent State of Croatia during the war. The memorial park was devastated in the 1990s and restoration began in 2015.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Mostarcima poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi 1941–1945; spomen-groblje je na Bijelom brijegu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the people of Mostar killed in the People's Liberation War of 1941–1945; the memorial cemetery is on Bijeli Brijeg.

opis.sh: Mauzolej u sećanje na više od 4.600 partizana i civila iz Čačka i okoline poginulih u ratu; u kripti su posmrtni ostaci palih boraca.
opis.en: Mausoleum in memory of more than 4,600 Partisans and civilians from Čačak and the surrounding area who died in the war; the crypt holds the remains of fallen fighters.

opis.sh: Posvećeno civilima iz bihaćkog kraja, pre svega Srbima i Jevrejima, koje su ustaše 1941. ubijale na Garavicama. Park je uređen na dve masovne grobnice sa oko 7.000 žrtava.
opis.en: Dedicated to the thousands of civilians from the Bihać area, mostly Serbs and Jews, killed by the Ustaše at Garavice in 1941. The park covers two mass graves holding about 7,000 victims.

opis.sh: Posvećeno đacima i profesorima koje su Nemci streljali u Šumaricama 21. oktobra 1941, u [odmazdi](Q685201) u kojoj su ubijene hiljade građana Kragujevca. Spomenik stoji gde je streljana najveća grupa učenika i 15 profesora.
opis.en: Dedicated to the pupils and teachers shot by the Germans at Šumarice on 21 October 1941, in a [reprisal](Q685201) that killed thousands of Kragujevac citizens. The monument stands where the largest group of pupils and 15 teachers were shot.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Dražgoškoj bici](Q4870916) iz januara 1942, kada su partizani [Cankarovog bataljona](Q12786675) danima branili selo od Nemaca, koji su ga posle spalili.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Battle of Dražgoše](Q4870916) of January 1942, when Partisans of the [Cankar Battalion](Q12786675) defended the village against the Germans for days; the Germans then burned it.

autor: Boris Kobe & Stojan Batič & Ive Šubic

opis.sh: Posvećeno mornarima i pomorcima poginulim u Drugom svetskom ratu; otkriven 10. septembra 1962, na 20. godišnjicu osnivanja [partizanske mornarice](Q18404751).
opis.en: Dedicated to the sailors and seamen who died in World War II; unveiled on 10 September 1962, the 20th anniversary of the founding of the [Partisan navy](Q18404751).

opis.sh: Spomenik u sećanje na više od 1.500 poginulih iz opštine Nikšić u Drugom svetskom ratu i na 32 partizana i antifašista koje su okupatori streljali na Trebjesi.
opis.en: In memory of the more than 1,500 people from the Nikšić municipality killed in World War II and of the 32 Partisans and anti-fascists executed by the occupiers on Trebjesa Hill.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi od 13. oktobra 1941, kada su Vrnjačko-trstenički partizanski odred i četa Kraljevačkog odreda, braneći Užičku republiku, ovde vodili višečasovnu borbu sa nemačkim snagama.
opis.en: Dedicated to the battle of 13 October 1941, when the Vrnjci–Trstenik Partisan Detachment and a company of the Kraljevo Detachment fought German forces here for hours in defence of the Republic of Užice.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama streljanja na Slobodištu, gde su nemački okupatori tokom rata ubili oko 1.650 ljudi, uglavnom partizana, četnika i njihovih pristalica i Roma.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the executions at Slobodište, where the German occupiers killed about 1,650 people during the war, mostly Partisans, Chetniks and their supporters, and Roma.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Narodnooslobodilačke borbe; podignut 1961. na centralnom Trgu bratstva i jedinstva u Prištini.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters who fell in the People's Liberation War; erected in 1961 on the central Brotherhood and Unity Square in Priština.

naziv.en: Monument to the Path of Martyrdom

opis.sh: Posvećeno streljanim Zagrepčanima, antifašistima i drugim žrtvama ustaškog terora u šumi Dotrščini, gde su tokom rata ubijene hiljade ljudi; danas je to zaštićeno spomen-područje.
opis.en: Dedicated to the thousands of Zagreb citizens, anti-fascists and other victims executed by the Ustaše in the Dotrščina forest during the war; today it is a protected memorial area.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima sahranjenim na groblju partizanske bolnice Bijeli Potoci–Kamensko na Plješevici, prve partizanske bolnice u Hrvatskoj, gde ih počiva oko 3.000.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters buried at the cemetery of the Bijeli Potoci–Kamensko hospital on Plješevica, the first Partisan hospital in Croatia, where about 3,000 lie.

opis.sh: Posvećeno tajnoj partizanskoj bolnici na Korčanici, u kojoj je od jeseni 1942. lečeno oko 2.800 ranjenika i obolelih od tifusa, i njenom osoblju.
opis.en: Dedicated to the secret Partisan hospital at Korčanica, which from autumn 1942 treated about 2,800 wounded and typhus patients, and to its medical staff.

naziv.en: Monument to the Start of the Uprising

opis.sh: Posvećeno početku ustanka u Srbiji: ovde je 7. jula 1941, na Ivanjdan, Rađevska četa Valjevskog partizanskog odreda sa Žikicom Jovanovićem Špancem ispalila prve hice.
opis.en: Dedicated to the start of the uprising in Serbia: here, on 7 July 1941, the Rađevina Company of the Valjevo Partisan Detachment, with Žikica Jovanović Španac, fired the first shots.

opis.sh: Posvećeno prvom zasedanju [ZAVNO Crne Gore i Boke](Q334224), održanom u Kolašinu 1943, i borbi Kolašinaca u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the first session of the [Anti-Fascist Council of Montenegro and Boka](Q334224), held in Kolašin in 1943, and to the people of Kolašin in the liberation war.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima i civilima iz ovog kraja poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi; istorija kraja uklesana je u kamen Spomenika slobode na brdu Jasikovac.
opis.en: Dedicated to the thousands of fighters and civilians from this region who died in the liberation war; the region's history is carved into the stones of the Monument to Freedom on Jasikovac Hill.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima NOVJ i žrtvama fašizma iz leskovačkog kraja poginulim u Drugom svetskom ratu; spomen-park je na brdu Hisar.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Partisan fighters and victims of fascism from the Leskovac area who died in World War II; the memorial park is on Hisar Hill.

naziv.en: Monument to the Victims of Fascism

opis.sh: Posvećeno zatočenicima logora Banjica i drugim žrtvama koje su okupatori tokom rata streljali na nekadašnjem [strelištu u Jajincima](Q1561988), gde su ubijene hiljade ljudi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the thousands of Banjica camp prisoners and other victims executed by the occupiers during the war at the former [firing range in Jajinci](Q1561988).

naziv.sh: Muzej Partijske škole CK KPJ (Vila Irena)
naziv.en: Memorial Museum of the KPJ Party School (Villa Irena)

opis.sh: Posvećeno Titovom govoru borcima 4. krajiške divizije, održanom ispred ove škole 7. januara 1943. Posle rata u njoj je uređen Muzej Podgrmeča, a 1979. postavljena je spomen-česma.
opis.en: Dedicated to Tito's speech to the fighters of the 4th Krajina Division, given in front of this school on 7 January 1943. After the war it became the Podgrmeč Museum, and a memorial fountain was added in 1979.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanima iz Prilepa i okoline poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi; ovde su zajednička grobnica i spomen-urne 462 borca.
opis.en: Dedicated to 462 Partisans from Prilep and the surrounding area who died in the liberation war; their common tomb and memorial urns are here.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Ivi Loli Ribaru](Q1265884), poginulom na aerodromu kod Glamoča 27. novembra 1943, kada je nemački avion bombardovao letelicu kojom je trebalo da odleti u Kairo.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Ivo Lola Ribar](Q1265884), killed at the airfield near Glamoč on 27 November 1943, when a German plane bombed the aircraft that was to fly him to Cairo.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Sarajlijama poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi i žrtvama fašizma.
opis.en: Dedicated to the people of Sarajevo who died in the liberation war and to the victims of fascism.

autor: Vladimir Dobrović & Alija Kučukalić & Aleksandar Maltarić

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnim herojima [Bori Vukmiroviću](Q1562871) i [Ramizu Sadiku](Q1568696), koji su ovde ubijeni 10. aprila 1943. i postali simbol zajedničke borbe Srba i Albanaca.
opis.en: Dedicated to People's Heroes [Boro Vukmirović](Q1562871) and [Ramiz Sadiku](Q1568696), killed here on 10 April 1943, who became a symbol of the joint struggle of Serbs and Albanians.

autor: Miodrag Pecić & Svetomir Arsić & Hilmija Ćatović

opis.sh: Posvećeno savetovanju rukovodstva partizana sa Titom, održanom u selu Stolice 26. septembra 1941, na kome je Glavni štab preimenovan u Vrhovni štab.
opis.en: Dedicated to the conference of the Partisan leadership with Tito, held in the village of Stolice on 26 September 1941, at which the General Staff was renamed the Supreme Headquarters.

naziv.en: Monument to the Battle of the Wounded

opis.sh: Posvećeno [bici za ranjenike na Neretvi](Q127872674) iz februara i marta 1943, kada su partizani uz parolu „Prozor noćas mora pasti!“ štitili 4.000 ranjenika Centralne bolnice.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Battle for the Wounded on the Neretva](Q127872674) in February and March 1943, when the Partisans, under the slogan "Prozor must fall tonight!", protected 4,000 wounded of the Central Hospital.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama [nemačkog koncentracionog logora](Q701910) na Sajmištu, u kome su 1941–1942. ubijeni gotovo svi zatočeni Jevreji, a potom su tu držani partizani i drugi zatvorenici.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the [German concentration camp](Q701910) at Sajmište, where almost all the Jews held there were killed in 1941–1942; it was then used for Partisans and other prisoners.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Mitru Trifunoviću Uči](Q4616422) iz obližnjeg Brvnika, istaknutom borcu radničkog pokreta, koji je stradao u logoru Jasenovac 1941.
opis.en: Dedicated to People's Hero [Mitar Trifunović Učo](Q4616422) from nearby Brvnik, a leading figure of the labour movement, who died in the Jasenovac camp in 1941.

naziv.en: Monument to Victims of the 1942 Raid

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama [Novosadske racije](Q1047674) iz januara 1942, kada su mađarski okupatori ubili više od 1.000 građana Novog Sada i bacili ih u zaleđeni Dunav.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the [Novi Sad raid](Q1047674) of January 1942, when the Hungarian occupiers killed more than 1,000 citizens of Novi Sad and threw them into the frozen Danube.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [bici na Neretvi](Q127872674) 1943, kada su partizani srušili most na Neretvi i preneli preko reke hiljade ranjenika.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Battle of the Neretva](Q127872674) in 1943, when the Partisans demolished the bridge over the Neretva and carried thousands of wounded across the river.

autor: Branko Tadić & Zdravko Dunđerović & Mustafa Ramić

naziv.en: Museum of the 2nd Session of AVNOJ

opis.sh: Posvećeno Drugom zasedanju AVNOJ-a, održanom u ovom domu 29. novembra 1943, na kome su postavljeni temelji nove Jugoslavije.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Second Session of AVNOJ, held in this hall on 29 November 1943, which laid the foundations of the new Yugoslavia.

opis.sh: Posvećeno ustanku 1941. i Užičkoj republici, kada su u Užicu bili Vrhovni štab i Tito; muzej je nastao kao Muzej ustanka 1941.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 1941 uprising and the Republic of Užice, when the Supreme Headquarters and Tito were based in the town; the museum began as the Museum of the 1941 Uprising.

naziv.sh: Muzej I. zasjedanja AVNOJ-a u Bihaću

opis.sh: Posvećeno Prvom zasedanju AVNOJ-a, političkog predstavništva Narodnooslobodilačkog pokreta, održanom u ovoj zgradi 26. i 27. novembra 1942.
opis.en: Dedicated to the First Session of AVNOJ, the political assembly of the Yugoslav liberation movement, held in this building on 26–27 November 1942.

opis.sh: Posvećeno boravku Vrhovnog štaba sa Titom u ovoj pećini početkom 1944. i [nemačkom desantu na Drvar](Q931125) 25. maja 1944, tokom koga se Tito iz nje izvukao.
opis.en: Dedicated to the stay of the Supreme Headquarters with Tito in this cave in early 1944 and to the [German airborne raid on Drvar](Q931125) on 25 May 1944, during which Tito escaped from it.

opis.sh: Etno-muzej oko rodne kuće Josipa Broza Tita, ispred koje je 1948. postavljen njegov spomenik.
opis.en: Open-air museum around the birth house of Josip Broz Tito, in front of which his statue was erected in 1948.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Prvoj proleterskoj brigadi](Q2190675), prvoj redovnoj jedinici partizanske vojske, formiranoj u Rudom 21. decembra 1941.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [1st Proletarian Brigade](Q2190675), the first regular unit of the Partisan army, formed in Rudo on 21 December 1941.

opis.sh: Tajna partizanska bolnica u klisuri kod Cerkna lečila je ranjenike od decembra 1943. do kraja rata, a Nemci je nikad nisu otkrili. Danas je obnovljena kao muzej.
opis.en: This secret Partisan hospital in a gorge near Cerkno treated the wounded from December 1943 to the end of the war and was never discovered by the Germans. Today it is a reconstructed museum.

opis.sh: Glavna tajna baza rukovodstva slovenačkih partizana u šumama Kočevskog roga 1943–1944, koju okupatori nikad nisu otkrili. Sačuvane barake danas su muzej.
opis.en: The main secret base of the Slovene Partisan leadership in the forests of Kočevski Rog in 1943–1944, never discovered by the occupiers. Its preserved huts are now a museum.

opis.sh: Posvećeno sedamnaestogodišnjem bombašu i narodnom heroju [Bošku Buhi](Q1280823), koji je ovde poginuo 27. septembra 1943, i pionirima i omladincima poginulim u ratu. Nekadašnji naziv je Muzej pionira i omladine Jugoslavije.
opis.en: Dedicated to seventeen-year-old grenadier and People's Hero [Boško Buha](Q1280823), killed here on 27 September 1943, and to the young people who died in the war. Its former name was the Museum of Yugoslav Pioneers and Youth.

naziv.en: Monu. to the Liberators of Skopje

opis.sh: Posvećeno oslobodiocima Skoplja, koje je oslobođeno 13. novembra 1944.
opis.en: Dedicated to the liberators of Skopje, which was freed on 13 November 1944.

opis.sh: Posvećeno učesnicima [Batinske bitke](Q2338734) iz novembra 1944, kada su jedinice NOVJ i Crvene armije forsirale Dunav kod Batine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the participants of the [Battle of Batina](Q2338734) in November 1944, when Yugoslav Partisan and Red Army units forced a crossing of the Danube at Batina.

naziv.en: Mem. House to 1st Session of ZAVNOBiH

opis.sh: Posvećeno Prvom zasedanju ZAVNOBiH-a, održanom u ovoj zgradi 25. novembra 1943, na kome je obnovljena državnost Bosne i Hercegovine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the First Session of ZAVNOBiH, held in this building on 25 November 1943, which restored the statehood of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašizma; Dolinarove figure postavljene su 1950. u Jajincima, a 1959. prenesene u Kraljevo.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen fighters and victims of fascism; Dolinar's figures were first erected at Jajinci in 1950 and moved to Kraljevo in 1959.

opis.sh: Grobnica Josipa Broza Tita i Jovanke Broz u krugu Muzeja Jugoslavije na Dedinju.
opis.en: The resting place of Josip Broz Tito and Jovanka Broz, on the grounds of the Museum of Yugoslavia in Dedinje.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima poginulim u [oslobođenju Beograda](Q328357) u oktobru 1944; ovde je sahranjeno 2.944 boraca NOVJ i 961 borac Crvene armije.
opis.en: Dedicated to the soldiers killed in the [liberation of Belgrade](Q328357) in October 1944; 2,944 Yugoslav Partisans and 961 Red Army soldiers are buried here.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnim herojima sahranjenim u grobnici ispred Narodnog muzeja Slovenije; na sarkofagu su reljefi iz Narodnooslobodilačke borbe i stihovi Otona Župančiča.
opis.en: Dedicated to the People's Heroes buried in the tomb in front of the National Museum of Slovenia; the sarcophagus bears reliefs from the liberation war and verses by Oton Župančič.

naziv.sh: Меморијален комплекс на паднатите борци на Револуцијата

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanima poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi; spomen-groblje je na istočnoj strani Štipske tvrđave.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Partisans who died in the liberation war; the memorial cemetery is on the eastern side of the Štip fortress.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim i streljanim žrtvama Drugog svetskog rata; ovde su bile zajedničke grobnice oko 10.000 ljudi.
opis.en: Dedicated to about 10,000 people killed and executed during World War II, on the site of their mass graves.
